mapper.select:
select id, yaopin_bianhao as yaopinBianhao, yaopin_mingcheng as yaopinMingcheng, guige, danwei, changjia, kucun, zhuyi_shixiang as zhuyiShixiang, zhuangtai from yaopin_xinxi where coalesce(zhuangtai, '启用') = '启用'
and yaopin_mingcheng like concat('%', #{yaopinMingcheng}, '%')
order by id desc
